changes: Company-owned native search field replaces stock Quasar table search anatomy.
Columns, Density, Export and Refresh share one compact toolbar action grammar.
Quick filter caches text and updates displayed/total record count without remounting.
All row/density/search/refresh update paths use the live AG Grid API; DataTable no longer calls element.update().
Row buffer reduced to 3; row animation and column-move animation are disabled; scroll position is preserved on data replacement.
Density is canonicalized to 44/38/34px rows with matching 46/40/36px headers.
Column manager uses Company-owned checkbox anatomy and stays synchronized with saved views.
Saved views are Company menu surfaces and can apply density, visibility, pinning, sorts and supported filters.
Numeric/percent/duration cells have deterministic formatters; trend cells use lightweight SVG mini-lines.
Inspect/Export row actions render as icon+label action pills; row double-click remains a primary detail path.
Low-priority responsive column classes now apply to both cells and headers.
Browser certification proves filter/density state, inspector actions, overlay ownership and no grid-root remount.
runtime_boundary: NiceGUI/browser runtime is unavailable in the build sandbox. Target runtime-contract, route smoke and browser certification remain required.
